description:
Repair unresolved, private-target, and redundant intra-doc links in the workspace public API documentation.

## Background

The Rust 1.95 public documentation build succeeds with cross-reference diagnostics in the core, coding, algebra, simulation, and SIMD-kernel crates. These diagnostics are reproducible at source revision deffa3d0cf0efb3f5ccecac380b615fa817bb401 with `./scripts/cargo-budget.sh cargo +1.95.0 doc --workspace --all-features --no-deps`. Representative sources include `gf2-core/src/compute/field.rs`, `gf2-core/src/field/charpoly.rs`, `gf2-core/src/field/inverse.rs`, `gf2-kernels-simd/src/transpose.rs`, and `gf2-sim/src/gpu/nr_5g_ldpc.rs` under `crates/`. They predate the calibration harness correction that exposed them.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The workspace public documentation build on Rust 1.95 reports no unresolved, private-target, or redundant intra-doc link diagnostics.
- [hard] REQ-02: Public cross-references resolve to the intended public item or use accurate plain text when the referenced implementation is private; library visibility and production behavior remain unchanged.
- [hard] REQ-03: References retain their mathematical and API meaning without suppressing Rustdoc diagnostics globally.
title: Repair public API documentation cross-references
